div.ab: swæse mæn in leodum ciriclicæs gemanan ungestrodyne þoligen.
Swæse mæn in leodum ciriclicæs gemanan ungestrodyne þoligen.
Our own men among the people [i.e., native] shall suffer loss of the community of the church without forfeiture of goods.
Men of our own country also shall be excluded from the communion of the Church, without being subject to forfeiture of their goods.
Our own men, in this people, are to forfeit the fellowship of the Church, without confiscating their goods.
heimische Männer im Volke kirchlicher Gemeinschaft verlustig gehen, [jedoch] ungepfändet.
native men among the people are to lose the communion of the Church, [but] without their goods being distrained.
